verdict.rationale: Freshsales' own marketing pages describe Freddy AI producing in-product insights and suggestions from CRM data: intent scores to prioritize leads, deal recommendations, and highlighting of the best leads and deals with insights. This is the story's core, but the evidence is only short first-party marketing lines. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the insights and recommendations work and what data they draw on, plan availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Focus on valuable leads with intent scores from Freddy AI.
Avoid bottlenecks and plan accurately with deal recommendations by Freddy AI.
highlighting the best leads and deals, offering insights, and even writing emails.
